section: Whether a Woman be with Childe or not
anchor: the person of the Querent
conditions: A woman asks whether she is with child.
condition_logic: Question context is required; the assignments are distinct roles, not interchangeable planets.
assertion: Assign lord1 and Moon to the woman asking; assign the fifth house and lord5 to conception, if any. The carryover calls lord5 the natural significator of children in this discussion.

section: Whether a Woman be with Childe or not
anchor: it argues the Woman is conceived
conditions: Lord1 is in the fifth OR lord5 is in the ascendant.
The relevant placement is free from all manner of impediments.
condition_logic: ((lord1 in fifth) OR (lord5 in ascendant)) AND freedom from impediments.
assertion: Lilly treats the unimpeded reciprocal house placement as an argument that the woman has conceived.

section: Whether a Woman be with Childe or not
anchor: the more certaine you may judge
conditions: Lord1's virtue or disposition is translated to a planet in an angle.
For increased certainty, the recipient is received by lord1 OR lord1 is received by the recipient.
condition_logic: Base route: translation from lord1 to an angular planet. Strengthening route: base AND (recipient received by lord1 OR lord1 received by recipient).
assertion: Translation to an angular planet is another conception testimony; reception in either stated direction strengthens the certainty of the judgment.
uncertainty: UB001: punctuation and reception attachment are retained without requiring mutual reception.

branches.when: The angular-translation route also has reception in either named direction
branches.then: Greater certainty, not a separately quantified probability.

section: Whether a Woman be with Childe or not
anchor: it's more like to be a Sicknesse
conditions: The planet to which lord1 commits his disposition is cadent.
The woman supposes conception; if conception holds, the adverse-outcome branch applies.
condition_logic: Cadent recipient is the base antecedent. Poor-end assertion is conditional on conception holding. The four-sign list is OR, as are the angular-malevolent and South Node emphases; their exact final attachment is not compiled.
assertion: Lilly associates the cadent recipient with grief and supposed conception more likely being sickness; if conception does hold, he expects a poor end. He especially emphasizes Aries, Cancer, Libra or Capricorn rising, a malevolent planet in an angle, or the South Node in the following context.
uncertainty: UB001: the attachment of the final South Node phrase is uncertain; separate fifth-house and ascendant outcomes follow in B005–B006.

branches.then: Grief; sickness judged more likely than conception.
Poor expected end, with the printed adverse emphases retained.

anchor: thereby have reconciled the Father or Mother and their Child
conditions: Considering the last part of this judgment.
condition_logic: Claimed transfer of an unspecified last part plus autobiographical success report; not independent validation.
assertion: Lilly proposes applying that last part to other questions and reports having used it many times to reconcile father or mother with their child.
uncertainty: UB024: last part and any other Question are not bounded enough to license a universal executable counseling rule.

section: Whether Unity is like to be betwixt the Infant and the Parent, or betwixt the Parent and any of his Children of elder Yeers
anchor: to deale fairly and really
conditions: An astrologer makes the preceding fault/unity judgment.
condition_logic: Ethical qualification applies regardless of whether the fault is assigned to parent or child; not a rule to favor the inquirer.
assertion: The author expressly requests fair and truthful dealing, wherever the fault lies.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: Lord of the fift shall represent the person
conditions: An embassy/ambassador question is asked.
condition_logic: Local role assignment: lord5 ambassador; Moon additional significator.
assertion: Assign lord5 to the ambassador, admitting Moon also to signification.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: shall shew the cause of his Embassage
conditions: Lord5 OR Moon applies to a planet.
condition_logic: Inspect recipient of lord5 application OR recipient of Moon application; the source expressly permits judgment from BOTH recipients.
assertion: The planet receiving either application shows the cause of the embassy; judgment may use both planets when lord5 and Moon apply to different recipients.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: upon a meer point of honour
conditions: Application is from a Fortune by square OR opposition OR conjunction.
There is reception between them OR collection OR translation of light by a planet.
The relevant planet is lord10 OR in the tenth.
condition_logic: UNRESOLVED source predicate grouping; retain Fortune-origin application with (square OR opposition OR conjunction), reception OR collection OR translation, and (lord10 OR tenth-house) role without replacing hard aspects with easy ones.
assertion: The embassy concerns the king on a point of honor, high/great business, or a very great and urgent occasion.
uncertainty: UB025: relevant-planet pronouns and the reception/collection/translation attachment are not fully resolved.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: he comes to renew the League of Friendship
conditions: The planet received OR collecting OR translating the virtue is lord11.
condition_logic: A planet in one of the stated reception/collection/translation roles is lord11; wider antecedent inheritance remains unforced.
assertion: The embassy is to renew the league of friendship between the two nations.
uncertainty: UB025: inheritance of the preceding Fortune/aspect conditions is not restated.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: no solid peace may be expected
conditions: Lord5 is unfortunate in the seventh.
Lord1 and lord5 are square OR opposite.
Mars casts a malicious aspect to either OR both of them.
condition_logic: Unfortunate lord5 in seventh AND (lord1 square OR opposite lord5) AND Mars maliciously aspects (lord1 OR lord5 OR both).
assertion: Lilly sees no likelihood of unity or contentment: both parties may find trivial ways to discontent the other; no solid peace is expected from the treaty/embassy, and variance is probable.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: whether the Embassadour will deale fairly or prove false
conditions: Question concerns ambassador fairness, falseness, or shuffling in undertakings.
condition_logic: Inspection of condition AND relevant aspect(s) AND house, without an invented good/bad score or rule that one testimony always wins.
assertion: Inspect lord5's good/ill condition, its aspect to ascendant, lord1 or lord11, and its house placement; the following concrete cases supply distinct conduct judgments.
uncertainty: UB031: same-witness house erratum has unresolved exact line/word applicability; no predicate changed.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: an overweening conceit of his owne abilities
conditions: Lord5 is in the tenth.
Lord5 is essentially dignified there.
condition_logic: Tenth-house lord5 AND essential dignity; both conditions are required for this specific source interpretation.
assertion: The ambassador is described as overinsistent on his prince's honor and overconfident in his own abilities.
exceptions: Essential dignity in this placement does not automatically imply a favorable conduct judgment.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: hath not a Commission large enough
conditions: Mercury and lord5 are square OR opposite.
condition_logic: Mercury square OR opposite lord5; outcomes are source alternatives, not all required to occur.
assertion: The author gives alternatives: too narrow a commission, countermand or contradiction by a dispatch from the prince, a dishonest secretary, or a badly received message.

branches.then: Insufficient commission OR prince's countermand/contradiction OR secretary's dishonesty OR ill-received message.

section: Of Embassadours or Messengers
anchor: will performe his trust with much sincerity
conditions: The ambassador's significator has sextile OR trine to lord1 OR the lord of the sign to which the present kingdom is subject.
condition_logic: (Sextile OR trine) to (lord1 OR kingdom-sign lord); essential dignity may be present OR absent.
assertion: Generally the ambassador wishes the kingdom well and performs his trust sincerely, whether his significator is well dignified or not.
exceptions: The source expressly removes good dignity as a prerequisite in this rule.
uncertainty: UB026: the kingdom-to-sign assignment is an external source dependency not supplied here; no national-sign table is invented.
UB006: coexistence with specific contrary conduct/treaty routes has no local arbitration rule.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: the Messenger, and managing of the Businesse
conditions: A messenger has been sent on an errand for money.
condition_logic: Four distinct source roles; preserve Moon-as-message and lord5-as-messenger.
assertion: Assign ascendant/lord1 to sender, seventh/lord7 to recipient, Moon to message, and lord5 to messenger and management of the business.
uncertainty: UB027: heading lettering is damaged after sent fo; this does not obscure the paragraph's roles.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: hath effected the thing he went about
conditions: Lord5 has separated from lord7.
Lord5 applies to lord1.
condition_logic: Separation from lord7 precedes application to lord1; both sequential conditions apply.
assertion: The messenger has accomplished the errand, left the recipient, and is returning home.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: whether a Fortune or Infortune be Lord of that house
conditions: Lord5 has separated from lord2.
condition_logic: Separation lord5 from lord2; lord2 may be Fortune OR Infortune. This qualification remains alongside the answer-quality rule.
assertion: The messenger brings money, whether the ruler of the second is a Fortune or an Infortune.
exceptions: An Infortune ruling the second does not negate the express brings-money output.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: the answer which the Messenger brings
conditions: Identify the planet from which lord5 has separated.
condition_logic: Find separation target → use planet nature AND its ruled-house nature; good-planet and Infortune outputs are alternative qualitative branches.
assertion: Judge the answer by both that planet's nature and the nature of the house it rules. Separation from a good planet gives hope of a good answer; separation from an Infortune gives the contrary.
exceptions: The source's second-house money rule is retained even when lord2 is an Infortune.

branches.then: Contrary qualitative answer testimony; does not erase explicit second-house money exception.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: before he is separated from the Lord of the seventh
conditions: Messenger significator applies square OR conjunction to an Infortune.
That application is before separation from lord7.
condition_logic: (Square OR conjunction to Infortune) temporally BEFORE separation from lord7 → recipient obstruction AND outbound hindrance; opposition is not substituted.
assertion: The messenger met obstruction in the business from the recipient and hindrance on the outward journey before arrival.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: will have delayes or misfortune in his returning home againe
conditions: The same application to an Infortune occurs after lord5 has separated from lord7.
condition_logic: Inherited (square OR conjunction to Infortune) temporally AFTER separation from lord7 → return-journey branch.
assertion: The messenger will have delays or misfortune on the return journey.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: he will hardly travell safe for Theeves
conditions: An Infortune is in the ninth.
condition_logic: Infortune in ninth is a distinct travel-risk route; no unspecified time direction is added.
assertion: Lilly says the messenger will hardly travel safely because of thieves.
exceptions: Hardly safely is the source's phrasing; it is not a claim that an actual theft is certain.

section: Of a Messenger sent [damaged lettering] upon any Errand for Money
anchor: his going and returning will be safe
conditions: A Fortune is in the ninth.
condition_logic: Fortune in ninth → safety for outward AND return travel; keep both stated stages.
assertion: The author judges both outward and return journeys safe.
uncertainty: UB006: no local rule settles simultaneous contrary ninth-house or journey testimonies.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: he then went safe to his journeys end
conditions: A foot-post, lackey or similar messenger is sent on an errand.
Lord1 OR Moon is in the seventh, OR one or both apply to lord7.
condition_logic: Foot-post/lackey question AND ((lord1 in seventh OR Moon in seventh) OR (lord1 applies lord7 OR Moon applies lord7 OR both)).
assertion: The author judges the messenger reached the journey's end safely, using lord1 and Moon in this local paragraph.
exceptions: Do not silently replace lord1 with lord5 to conform to the preceding sender/messenger role assignment.
uncertainty: UB028: the local lord1/Moon use is explicit but its relationship to the preceding lord5 scheme is not explained.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: what is his Vertue, what his Debility
conditions: Making the messenger/journey judgment.
condition_logic: Contextual assessment inputs are planet nature AND dignity/strength/debility AND significant-house placement; no universal fixed weight is supplied.
assertion: Judge according to the nature and dignity of Fortune/Infortune, its strength and debility, and occupation of significant houses; Fortunes portend good and Infortunes the contrary in the described context.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: well received and entertained
conditions: There is reception between lord5 and lord7.
An amicable aspect connects them.
condition_logic: Reception AND amicable aspect; subsequent hard-aspect branch is a distinct qualification.
assertion: The messenger was welcomed and entertained by the recipient.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: framed some excuse
conditions: Reception between lord5 and lord7 is retained from context.
Their application is by square OR opposition.
condition_logic: Reception AND (square OR opposition application) → welcome BUT excuse/defence; do not retain amicable-aspect requirement simultaneously.
assertion: Even under these hard aspects the messenger was well received, but the recipient made an excuse or presented a defence concerning the requested thing.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: say, he commeth
conditions: Lord5 has receded from lord7 OR applies to the planet who is his dispositor.
condition_logic: (Lord5 receded from lord7) OR (lord5 applying to his dispositor); these are alternatives, not an AND requirement.
assertion: The source treats either route as showing the messenger coming back.
uncertainty: UB029: his most naturally refers to lord5 but the pronoun is not expanded in the text; the exact application target is kept source-bound.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: give Days, Weeks or Moneths
conditions: Return timing is sought.
Use the number of degrees of the relevant application.
condition_logic: Application degrees → choose Days OR Weeks OR Months using journey AND sign nature; do not fabricate a fixed/common/movable unit mapping.
assertion: Convert application degrees to days, weeks or months according to journey nature/length and whether signs are fixed, common or movable.
uncertainty: UB030: no fixed sign-class-to-time-unit table or distance convention is given in this passage.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: the Messenger will returne when he comes to be Direct
conditions: The messenger significator is retrograde.
condition_logic: Retrograde condition → direct-station date OR degrees-remaining method; both source alternatives are preserved.
assertion: The author gives return when the significator becomes direct, or timing according to the degrees still lacking before direct motion.
uncertainty: UB030: the alternative degrees-to-station conversion and its units are not specified locally.

branches.then: Time by degrees lacking before direct motion; conversion unresolved.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: that day, or neer it, the Messenger is heard of
conditions: Lord5 comes to sextile OR trine of lord1.
condition_logic: (Sextile OR trine lord5 to lord1) → reported news event on or near that day, not an exact-return guarantee.
assertion: Lilly reports his usual observation that the messenger is heard of that day or near it.
exceptions: News of the messenger is not automatically his physical return; retain or near it.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: the Querent shall have intelligence of his Messenger
conditions: Moon separates from lord5 to lord1.
condition_logic: Ordered lunar relation: from lord5 TO lord1; do not reverse the source/target or collapse this to unsequenced aspects.
assertion: The author gives this lunar sequence as another time at which the querent receives intelligence of the messenger.
exceptions: The event is receiving intelligence, not necessarily the messenger's arrival.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: shewes more certainly the day
conditions: The relevant significator applies to a ponderous planet.
condition_logic: Ponderous target is a certainty-strengthening qualification, not a replacement for every preceding timing route.
assertion: Application to a ponderous planet makes the day indicated by the messenger timing more certain in the author's account.
exceptions: More certain is comparative verbal confidence, not a measured accuracy improvement.

section: Unnumbered Foot-Posts/Lackeys, reception, return, and news
anchor: the length or brevity of the Journey
conditions: Interpreting the preceding messenger timing testimonies.
condition_logic: Closing interpretive qualification retained from top PDF272 before the next chart; it supplies no extra fixed time formula.
assertion: Use discretion informed by the length or brevity of the journey and the foregoing rules.
